title: xDrip issue: master recieving readings but followers receive missed readings
body:
My xDrip is working and I am the master, I am recieving readings but the rest of my followers also do receive the reading but just in the form of missed readings. For example the phone shows my blood sugar level is 100 and is going down, my parents do receive the reading but it show missed reading since 60 minutes on them.
![Screenshot_2021-06-04-03-26-15-727_com eveningoutpost dexdrip](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85319197/120719994-b7ca2d00-c4e4-11eb-808f-5e2c004d4ecb.jpg)
See in the picture above as master it will show the reading correctly but that is what my parents see even thought it's the correct reading it says that it has been missed since 1 hour even though it's not and it just keeps sending new readings but doesn't change missed reading. What should I do?

comments.body:
